Transfer gate safety is guarded by STEP6 and TRANSFER PRECONDITION, both unchanged. Risks: S17 could transfer too early (the bare 'okay' wording is there to prevent it); S24 already passes on 'yep' and should stay the same. About +90 words (~1% prompt), so first-action p50 should stay near 650ms, under 700ms.
